program.title: BEng in Microelectronics and Integrated Circuits
uncertain: total_required_credits (82.0) is the sum of the required_credits of all groups. The Research Option is optional ('Students may opt to graduate with or without an option'); its required credits (3) and elective credits (6) are included in the total, but a student would complete at most one option.

Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. ELEC/MATH 6-7 block, MATH 4-6 calc block, COMP 4-5 block, the capstone block with multiple valid combinations), so actual credits may differ from the lower-bound calculation.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 MEIC (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
